Procedure HF-01 has thresholds on five annotation types: FS (FS > 60.0 for SNPs and FS > 200.0 for INDELs) [G:Threshold:FS_gt_60_snp] [G:Threshold:FS_gt_200_indel], MQRankSum (< -12.5) [G:Threshold:MQRankSum_lt_-12.5], MQ (< 40.0) [G:Threshold:MQ_lt_40], QD (< 2.0) [G:Threshold:QD_lt_2], and ReadPosRankSum (< -8.0) [G:Threshold:ReadPosRankSum_lt_-8] [G:Procedure:HF-01]. The sub-graph was truncated with one more neighbour omitted, so any further thresholds of HF-01 are not covered.
